narrative:
No non-compliant items were identified on this inspection. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the 
applicant. 
 
Regulated activity may continue at all regulated sites until expiration of the current license. At that time, conducting 
regulated activity from any site without a valid USDA license is a violation of the Animal Welfare Act.  
 
This site is determined to be in compliance. All sites used for regulated activity must demonstrate full compliance with the 
Animal Welfare Act prior to issuance of a license.  
 
Each applicant for a license must demonstrate that his or her locations and any animals, facilities, vehicles, equipment, or 
other locations used or intended for use in the business comply with the Animal Welfare Act (AWA) and the regulations 
and standards. The purpose of this inspection is to help USDA ascertain your compliance with the AWA and regulations 
and standards. 
 
We will send a copy of your new license to you within 30 days, unless additional review is required. You do not need to 
take further action at this time. If you have not received your license within 30 days, please contact the USDA at 970-494-
7478. 
 
Conducting regulated activities prior to issuance of a valid USDA license is a violation of the Animal Welfare Act.
